records.notes: COMPLEX RECORD - the Limantour tangle. File exceeds the 100MB Read limit (258 images / 184MB); split with pdfseparate+pdfunite to read the front matter (source pp1-16) and the tail (source pp236-255). No Hoffman flags; grant decree corroborates name/year/governor/grantee exactly (Cienega del Gabilan / 26 Oct 1843 / Micheltorena / Antonio Chaves, 11 sq leagues). Three-layer claimant history under docket 782/SD 314: (1) Jose Y. Limantour claimed as purchaser from Chaves (Board rejected 1855; Limantour's title was part of his notorious forgery scheme, and the US's 1864 DC memorandum, tp224-234, argues the presented grant was 'forged & fraudulent' and that Carr bought with notice); (2) Thomas O. Larkin also claimed and appealed the Board rejection to the DC (1857); (3) Larkin's executors sold to Jesse D. Carr (1860), who was substituted as appellant and ultimately obtained confirmation. Despite the US forgery argument, the case proceeded to survey (Carr's $500 survey deposit April 1866) and, per the register + Hoffman, to confirmation and patent (Carr, 15 Oct 1867, glo 250, 48,780.72 acres = ~11 leagues). Outcome graded PART because the file shows the claim advancing to survey/patent (confirmation) but I did not locate the explicit decree of confirmation in the pages read and there is no patent copy in the file. Recommend Phase C confirm GLO patent 250 and, if a re-read is warranted, search the unread middle (source pp17-235) for the DC decree of confirmation.
